item.name: Pricing
item.description:
Price (BDT) = baseFee + ceil(max(0, weight - baseWeightKg)) × perKgFee, i.e. extra weight is charged per started kg.
Rule lookup: active rule for (serviceType, originZone, destinationZone), else the service's default rule (both zones null).
No rule → 422. Weight above the rule's maxWeightKg → 422. Money fields are strings (Decimal).

request.description: Public so the frontend can quote before sign-up. Uses the same calculation as shipment create. Seeded SAME_DAY rules exist only within a zone, so SAME_DAY between zones returns 422.

item.name: Shipments
item.description:
All routes need a Bearer token. Scope: CUSTOMER sees own shipments, COURIER sees assigned ones, ADMIN sees all.
Shipments outside your scope return 404 (not 403) so ids can't be probed.
Price is always calculated on the server; sending price/status/trackingId returns 400.

request.description: Helper: saves {{destinationHubId}} for Create shipment.

Each hub must be active and belong to the zone sent with it. Creates the shipment (PENDING, UNPAID), a status-history row and an audit row in one transaction. trackingId: CRV-YYMMDD-XXXXXX (Dhaka date). Saves {{shipmentId}} and {{trackingId}}.
